item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00350","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C15","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied a reusable template for the child. Both are Kennedy letters to the congressional presiding officers that transmit housing-related legislation implementing recommendations from an earlier presidential message, briefly identify the bill's component programs, explain the urgent national need, and point to agency material for further detail. The close sequence and shared phrasing exceed mere subject overlap or a generic request for congressional action. C15 has a similarly close transmission-and-summary structure but concerns health legislation; C03 is a more elaborate legislative-transmittal letter whose emergency-program structure is less closely matched.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am pleased to transmit to you, for consideration by the Congress, a bill including the principal legislative recommendations of this Administration for housing and urban improvement. These measures are intended to carry out the proposals set forth in my message to the Congress on March 9.","parent_excerpt":"I am transmitting herewith drafts of two bills designed to carry out recommendations set forth in my message of February 20th to the Congress for assistance to institutions of higher education.","explanation":"Both openings use the same concrete legislative-transmittal formula: bills are sent to Congress specifically to implement recommendations in a previously identified presidential message."},{"child_excerpt":"The bill includes the extension of a number of programs previously approved by Congress... It also proposes vigorous new lines of action...","parent_excerpt":"One bill provides for the construction of academic facilities and for undergraduate scholarships. The other bill provides for housing facilities for the students.","explanation":"Each letter follows the opening with a compact inventory of the legislation's principal program components, including housing assistance."},{"child_excerpt":"I hope these proposals will have the early and serious consideration of the Congress so they may soon be put to work for the benefit of all the people.","parent_excerpt":"I consider enactment of this legislation vital... steps must be taken immediately... I consider the need critical and the program urgent.","explanation":"Both conclude their substantive presentation by stressing urgency and the importance of prompt enactment."}]}
